prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a finished desktop website screenshot, edge to edge with no browser frame, for Martino Ferrero's personal portfolio. He is a systems engineer working in backend engineering, artificial intelligence and medical imaging research. Recruiters and potential clients visit to understand his experience, see his work and contact him. The readable English screen must show 'Martino Ferrero', 'Backend engineering & artificial intelligence', 'View projects', plus navigation Home, About, Projects, Skills and Contact. Show the beginning of the projects section with the real names Neurollow and Lookeate; keep project descriptions minimal and do not invent details. Integrate the supplied caricature as a small portrait. This is a familiar polished developer portfolio: a spacious introduction leading into an easy-to-scan sequence of project entries. Use a near-black background, subtle dark blue and violet gradients, clear modern typography and a sparse constellation of fine neural connections. Keep the fixed navigation transparent, the page continuous and the tone professional. Avoid modal windows, dense card grids and excessive icons.
